headline: Where Fashion Meets Business Acumen
intro: BS4F is Bocconi University's leading fashion association. We bring together students with a passion for fashion and the analytical rigour of a top-tier business education.

majorProjects.title: Milan Fashion Week Coverage
majorProjects.description: Annual show coverage including press access, editorial production, and a flagship wrap-up evening at Bocconi.

majorProjects.title: Paris Fashion Week Delegation
majorProjects.description: BS4F sends a select delegation to PFW each season to attend shows, conduct interviews, and produce exclusive editorial content.

majorProjects.title: Sustainability in Luxury Forum
majorProjects.description: A half-day forum in partnership with Bocconi SDG Lab, featuring executives from Kering, Moncler, and OTB Group.

notableWins: Press accreditation at MFW & PFW for two consecutive seasons
Partnership with BoF for exclusive student rate
Featured in Corriere della Sera Campus supplement
Speaker series with executives from LVMH, Kering, and OTB
